limitations: This matrix routes accepted shared execution requirements to domain-owned knowledge; it does not create writer support.
Every domain's own support, review, freshness, and evidence gates remain authoritative.

requirements: Resolve every component by registry ID and deployment coordinate.
Read system-wide values at one block coordinate and preserve component-call failures.
Do not infer writer entrypoints from component relationships alone.
Bind the position, price, rate, fee, cap, and recovery-mode inputs to a recorded read set.
Apply operation-specific max-fee/value/approval preconditions and simulate the exact borrower entrypoint.
Reconcile receipt events and the post-state position; do not use UI maximum-capacity prose as the borrowable amount.
Bind hints, rate, price, attempted amount, and user minimum-fill/net-output policy to a fresh quote/read set.
Simulate the exact call; the deployed entrypoint has no on-chain minimum-received argument.
Reconcile attempted versus actual fill, fees, events, and remaining MUSD; a successful receipt can still represent a partial economic outcome.
Resolve current registry identities and proxy implementations, bind lock maximums and epoch windows to the selected deployment, and simulate the exact entrypoint.
Preserve Solidity floor order for lock power, relative vote allocation, boost, and emission-index calculations.

Reconcile lock ownership/amount/end, vote target weights and voting flag, stored boost checkpoints, or explicit gauge/reward claim outcomes as appropriate; do not reconcile from APY or planner output.
Do not publish route writers until active route peers, representations, direction, contract/network registry identities, quote/instruction construction, and qualified review are complete.
Source receipt confirmation is not cross-chain success; reconciliation must track provider message/attestation evidence and destination delivery.

For the scoped MUSD NTT routes, join source TransferSent and destination TransferRedeemed by the same transfer digest; contract manual-relaying mode does not establish a user-manual requirement or automatic-delivery SLA.

For Native Bridge, join the direction-specific sequence tuple rather than an NTT digest. Inbound ERC-20 completion additionally requires mapped-token recipient post-state because sequence acceptance can skip a blocked, unmapped, or failed mint; outbound completion requires AssetsUnlockConfirmed plus gross equals fee plus net delivery.
Timeout or absent destination evidence remains pending or ambiguous unless provider-specific proof establishes failure.
